infobox.effect: Provides 16 inventory slots while only taking up 2

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Info
sections.text:
The Document case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 16 inventory slots in a 4x4 grid and only takes up 2 inventory slots itself. It can only store:
- Currency
- Keys & Keycards
- Posters
- Maps
- Info items
- Keycard holder case
- DesmondPilak CD
- Physical Bitcoin
- Veritas guitar pick

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from The Punisher - Part 5
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Out of Curiosity
